title: A product wire removed does not establish full service advantage
statement: An ideal matched wired head reaches the same nominal charge in500.448294s versus the two-control500.585357s before missing protection. Braun--Schwartz2016 main0--469 supplies existing wireless microjet deposition on prepared floating gold; Percoco2026 main199--455 supplies sponge/brush/pump/plating plus encapsulation with external connections and finite sponge service. Nine cases/three steps and conservation checks remain model consistency. FoleyDoyle--Brady--Forster2026 first403 is held, with no snippet-derived topology/PEDOT performance imported. No complete geometry, life or cost advantage is claimed.
